name: en_irrelevant_traps
description: Requirements that mention input words without being about input (uploaded photos appearing, a login date, an invoice in the form of a PDF, enterprise customers, a quoted 'Quick pay' label, a session that ends on logout). Only the delivery address form needs questions.
requirements:
REQ-1: Uploaded photos should appear in the gallery within 3 seconds.
REQ-2: After login, the dashboard shows the account type and the last login date.
REQ-3: The monthly invoice is generated in the form of a PDF document.
REQ-4: Enterprise customers see a dedicated support phone number on the help page.
REQ-5: The session expires when the user logs out.
REQ-6: The "Quick pay" button is shown on the cart page.
REQ-7: The user enters a delivery address in the checkout form.

issues.note: what happens with the entered address

must_not_ask.note: 'after login' is a precondition; 'login date' is a value
'in the form of' is not a form
expiry is tied to an event, not a number

rule.missing_error_handling.REQ-7.value: Missing or invalid fields are highlighted and the order cannot be placed.

rule.missing_expected_result.REQ-7.value: The address is saved to the order and shown in the summary.
